text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as the Victoria Mile approaches――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa... phew――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(The Victoria Mile... where I promised my 
community members I'd make a comeback... I 
can't afford to run half-heartedly.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I'll definitely get results here and 
bring courage to all my community members 
who are struggling right now!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the day of the Victoria Mile 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Tokyo Racecourse holding races behind 
closed doors, there was no sign of crowds, 
leaving it so quiet that it hardly felt 
like a GⅠ race day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Faced with that silence, I can't help 
but wonder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I couldn't help but wonder if all my 
races from now on would end up like this—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: It really is so quiet...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Today is the glamorous spring festival 
where the elite Tiara Umamusume gather. 
Usually, it'd be bustling with a huge 
crowd, but...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I can't... hear your voice...—
—Thank you for having me today!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It really does feel lonely, doesn't it? 
When it gets this quiet. ...However—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I won't let this atmosphere get to me. 
I'll just run and win, like always!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Because that's who Almond Eye is.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (...Ai-san really is so cool.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Straightforward, powerful, and dazzling. 
...Harboring a light that won't lose to 
anything.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Even now, her commanding presence is so 
overwhelming I can't take my eyes off her. 
It's precisely because she's Ai-san that—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I won't lose either. Not to this 
silence... and not to Ai-san!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(And deliver my love... to the community 
members!!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: You're on. ——I'll show you how I run!
